Protection you can see and control

An unusual purchase should lead to a clear decision, not a confusing phone call. One in-app confirmation helps you keep legitimate spending moving.

When a card is compromised, the proposed service connects protection and recovery—so supported digital access can resume while the physical card is on its way.

Convenience: a clear next step.
Security: block suspicious activity.
Trust: an explanation and a recovery path.

Proposed capability, not a currently available bank offer. Wallet eligibility and issuer approval would apply. Fraud prevention and uninterrupted access cannot be guaranteed.
